title: Missing rate limiting on auth endpoint
explanation: The /api/v2/users/auth endpoint has no rate limiting, enabling brute-force and credential stuffing attacks.
fix: Implement Redis-backed rate limiter: max 5 requests/minute per IP with exponential backoff.

title: Unauthenticated analytics export
explanation: The /api/v3/analytics/export route returns full dataset without requiring auth headers.
fix: Add JWT auth middleware and validate "analytics:read" scope before processing.

title: API key in query string
explanation: API keys are passed as URL query parameters, exposing them in logs and browser history.
fix: Move to Authorization header using Bearer scheme. Update all client SDKs.
